evidence.observation: Reads ~441-446 °C and creeps steadily upward, wholly implausible versus reboiler T703 ~70 °C and second reboiler heater T702 ~63 °C
Column heater temperatures decay monotonically from ~75-84 °C toward ~63-67 °C, so the column is cooling rather than holding a separation profile
Reboiler essentially flat at 69.9→70.8 °C with no boil-up progression
Distillate and reflux flows hover near zero with erratic 0-1.8 spikes, i.e. no sustained takeoff or reflux
Column pressure drop stays 0.6-0.7 mbar, indicating negligible vapour traffic

args.missing_evidence: An independent reboiler-heater temperature reading or T701 sensor/wiring check to confirm the 441 °C value is a sensor fault rather than real, plus a distillate composition (GC) sample to test whether any separation occurred
